items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I think we had Cuffey, I remember Cuffey real well.

ctx.x: See, because Cy St. Clair got me the job. And he was on all the records that I made, he's there before me and after me also. Now here's another guy, Cuffey on trombone.
Right. But I'm saying if you're not listed they may not be listed either, I can only go, there are some of these dates -
